notes.title: Git Gud Contest [Winner Gets $1000]
notes.content:
[b]Beat the final level on Git Gud[/b] - Join the Competition!

The competition starts on release day [b]June 18th 10:00 AM PDT[/b], and it’s your chance to show your skills. Complete Level 12 in the full game [b]$3.99 USD[/b] and claim your spot among the winners!  
[h2][b]
Prizes: [/b][/h2]
💰 [b]1st Place:[/b] $1000  
💰 [b]2nd Place:[/b] $500  
💰 [b]3rd Place:[/b] $250  
💰 [b]4th–20th Place:[/b] $50 each  
💰 [b]21st-40th Place:[/b] $25 each  

[i]*Prizes will be sent in USD via PayPal, gift cards, or a preferred method. [/i]

[h2][b]How to Enter:[/b][/h2]
1️⃣ [b]Complete Level 12:[/b] Finish the level in the full game (not the demo).  

2️⃣ [b]Record Your Run:  [/b]
   Upload an unedited video of your completion to platforms like:  
   - [b]YouTube[/b] (set to public or unlisted)  
   - [b]Twitch VOD[/b] (make sure it doesn’t expire)  
   - [b]Kick, Facebook Gaming,[/b] or similar platforms with timestamps.  

3️⃣ [b]Share Your Entry:  [/b]
   Post your video in the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3252380/discussions/]Steam Git Gud community[/url][/b] with the title:  
   [b]"Git Gud Champion: [Your Name] – Level 12 Completion"[/b]
   Make sure the video upload date matches the date of your post.  

[h2][b]Rules to Keep It Fair:  [/b][/h2]
✅ Only Level 12 needs to be recorded—no full-game footage required.  
✅ No game speed changes (e.g., speed hacks).  
✅ No tools like Cheat Engine or anything that alters physics or gameplay.  
✅ Your footage must be unedited and continuous (no cuts).  
✅ One prize per person/IP. Multiple accounts will be disqualified.  

We’ll review the [b]first 20 valid submissions[/b], so don’t miss your chance to participate.  

Wishlist the game now to know when it launches, and start practicing in the demo to stay ahead of the game. 🎮  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3305620/Git_Gud_Demo/

Catch you soon,  
Sam
